_doc: Waystation contracts (ADR-0039): templates the trader's board deals out by the day; each offer picks its building from target (tier band, distance from the post). An accepted contract still open after expires_days (default 3) fails at dawn and costs fail_rep (default 10) standing; abandoning one costs abandon_rep (default 5) (TD-146). Story quests name their targets in objectives.

defs.name: Clear a building
defs.briefing: The Program wants {building} emptied: every Hollowed in it put down and its stores searched. {distance} out.

defs.name: Clear a building
defs.briefing: {building} has to be cleared before a survey team goes in: every Hollowed, and its stores searched. {distance} out.

defs.name: Clear a hard building
defs.briefing: Nobody has come back from {building}. Clear it and search its stores. {distance} out. Hazard pay.

defs.name: Recover a Program cache
defs.briefing: A survey team left a sealed cache in {building} and didn't come back for it. Bring it here. {distance} out.

defs.name: Recover a Program cache
defs.briefing: There's a Program cache in {building}, deep inside. Bring it back sealed. {distance} out.

defs.name: Bring in a Bloom core
defs._doc: TD-179: the one contract on a tier-5 site (the Corvane Field Lab, unique per random world). The lab's vault always holds a sealed core, so nothing is set down (`place` false); the contract is ready while the player carries one and pays well over its 240-scrip sale. `fresh` false: offered even after the player has been inside. Once turned in, never dealt again. A week to get there and back (expires_days, TD-146).
defs.briefing: The Program lost a field lab: {building}, {distance} out. Its vault holds a sealed Bloom core. Bring one back intact and the Program will remember you.

defs.name: Hold a cache
defs.briefing: A drone set a relay cache down by {building}. Its beacon draws them. Hold it until the uplink finishes. {distance} out.

defs.name: Hold a cache
defs.briefing: A relay cache by {building} has to upload. Everything for half a kilometre will hear it. Hold it. {distance} out.
